name: Ventio Mortis
source:
Ventio Mortis is a horror dating sim, where you play as Hollowelle Neaera, an undead creature of sorts, cursed by her own black magic to walk the earth forever until her bitter vengeance is finally satiated. With her are her dearest wards: Napoleon, a creature sewn together from all of Hollowelle's favorite bits and pieces of prettier people, and topped off with the heart of her would-be lover, had things taken another turn. Inan, the man with the steady hand, and the only ward Hollowelle has ever kept for more than a hundred years or so, due to his incredible capacity to thrive in his afterlife and lack of ties to his humanity. And of course, Drisdon, the unwavering lapdog, which despite his many faults, has stayed on Hollowelle's crew through sheer determination and his ability to make up for his mistakes ten-fold. Hollowelle and her bund require living flesh and blood in order to sustain themselves comfortably, else they'll be nothing more than barely breathing rotting corpses. However, when the newest member of the bund, Robbie, begins causing problems with Drisdon for seemingly no reason, it must be put to a stop lest the two big-mouth pugilists give way to the bund's unsavory doings.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=46693]Lemmasoft forums[/url]]
translation:
《Ventio Mortis》是一款恐怖约会模拟游戏，你将扮演Hollowelle Neaera，一种类似不死生物的角色，被自己的黑魔法诅咒，永远在地球上行走，直到她的痛苦复仇最终得到满足。和她在一起的是她最亲爱的监护人：拿破仑，一个由霍洛韦尔最喜欢的所有漂亮人的碎片缝制而成的生物，并以她未来情人的心为顶部，如果事情发生了另一个转变。伊南，这个手脚稳健的人，也是霍洛韦尔一百多年来唯一保留的监护人，因为他在来世有着令人难以置信的蓬勃发展的能力，而且与他的人性缺乏联系。当然，德里斯登，这只坚定不移的哈巴狗，尽管有很多缺点，但凭借绝对的决心和十倍弥补错误的能力，它仍然留在了霍洛韦尔的船员中。霍洛韦尔和她的同伴需要活生生的血肉来维持舒适的生存，否则他们就只不过是勉强呼吸的腐烂尸体。然而，当联盟的最新成员罗比似乎无缘无故地开始与德里斯顿制造麻烦时，必须制止这两个大嘴巴的拳击手，以免这两个大嘴拳击手屈服于联盟的令人厌恶的行为。
